[SWS_DM_00148] Persistent storage of event memory entries
⌈
The DM
shall be able to persistently store the status of all DTCs and its DTC related data:
• snapshot data if configured (at least one corresponding DiagnosticTrouble-
CodeProps.freezeFrame reference exists in the configuration)
• extended data if configured (at least one corresponding DiagnosticTrouble-
CodeProps.extendedDataRecord reference exists in the configuration)
⌋
